imports:
- path: workload-identity.jinja

resources:
- name: github-wif
  type: workload-identity.jinja
  properties:
    projectId: {{ env["project"] }}
    projectNumber: {{ env["project_number"] }}
    poolId: github-actions-pool
    poolDisplayName: GitHub Actions Pool
    poolDescription: Workload Identity Pool for GitHub Actions OIDC federation
    providerId: github-provider
    providerDisplayName: GitHub OIDC Provider
    issuerUri: https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
    githubOrg: REPLACE_WITH_GITHUB_ORG
    githubRepo: REPLACE_WITH_GITHUB_REPO
    serviceAccountId: github-cloudrun-deployer
    serviceAccountDisplayName: GitHub Actions Cloud Run Deployer
    serviceAccountDescription: Service account impersonated by GitHub Actions to deploy Cloud Run services

outputs:
- name: workloadIdentityProvider
  value: $(ref.github-wif.workloadIdentityProvider)
- name: serviceAccountEmail
  value: $(ref.github-wif.serviceAccountEmail)
- name: poolName
  value: $(ref.github-wif.poolName)

---
# workload-identity.jinja
{% set projectId = properties['projectId'] %}
{% set projectNumber = properties['projectNumber'] %}
{% set poolId = properties['poolId'] %}
{% set providerId = properties['providerId'] %}
{% set saId = properties['serviceAccountId'] %}
{% set saEmail = saId + '@' + projectId + '.iam.gserviceaccount.com' %}
{% set githubOrg = properties['githubOrg'] %}
{% set githubRepo = properties['githubRepo'] %}

resources:

- name: enable-iamcredentials
  type: deploymentmanager.v2.virtual.enableService
  properties:
    consumerId: project:{{ projectId }}
    serviceName: iamcredentials.googleapis.com

- name: enable-iam
  type: deploymentmanager.v2.virtual.enableService
  properties:
    consumerId: project:{{ projectId }}
    serviceName: iam.googleapis.com

- name: enable-sts
  type: deploymentmanager.v2.virtual.enableService
  properties:
    consumerId: project:{{ projectId }}
    serviceName: sts.googleapis.com

- name: enable-run
  type: deploymentmanager.v2.virtual.enableService
  properties:
    consumerId: project:{{ projectId }}
    serviceName: run.googleapis.com

- name: {{ poolId }}
  type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.locations.workloadIdentityPools
  properties:
    parent: projects/{{ projectId }}/locations/global
    workloadIdentityPoolId: {{ poolId }}
    workloadIdentityPool:
      displayName: {{ properties['poolDisplayName'] }}
      description: {{ properties['poolDescription'] }}
      disabled: false
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
    - enable-iam
    - enable-sts

- name: {{ providerId }}
  type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.locations.workloadIdentityPools.providers
  properties:
    parent: projects/{{ projectId }}/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/{{ poolId }}
    workloadIdentityPoolProviderId: {{ providerId }}
    workloadIdentityPoolProvider:
      displayName: {{ properties['providerDisplayName'] }}
      disabled: false
      attributeMapping:
        google.subject: assertion.sub
        attribute.actor: assertion.actor
        attribute.repository: assertion.repository
        attribute.repository_owner: assertion.repository_owner
        attribute.ref: assertion.ref
        attribute.event_name: assertion.event_name
        attribute.aud: assertion.aud
      attributeCondition: "assertion.repository_owner == '{{ githubOrg }}'"
      oidc:
        issuerUri: {{ properties['issuerUri'] }}
        allowedAudiences:
        - https://iam.googleapis.com/projects/{{ projectNumber }}/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/{{ poolId }}/providers/{{ providerId }}
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
    - {{ poolId }}

- name: {{ saId }}
  type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.serviceAccounts
  properties:
    accountId: {{ saId }}
    projectId: {{ projectId }}
    serviceAccount:
      displayName: {{ properties['serviceAccountDisplayName'] }}
      description: {{ properties['serviceAccountDescription'] }}
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
    - enable-iam

- name: {{ saId }}-wif-binding
  type: gcp-types/iam-v1:virtual.projects.serviceAccounts.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    resource: projects/{{ projectId }}/serviceAccounts/{{ saEmail }}
    role: roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser
    member: principalSet://iam.googleapis.com/projects/{{ projectNumber }}/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/{{ poolId }}/attribute.repository/{{ githubOrg }}/{{ githubRepo }}
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
    - {{ saId }}
    - {{ providerId }}

- name: {{ saId }}-run-developer
  type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    resource: {{ projectId }}
    role: roles/run.developer
    member: serviceAccount:{{ saEmail }}
